_comment: Multichain operator config (2026-07-15, 'Полный вперёд'). One process, one legs map — this operator verifies/signs against every chain in .legs from a single OPERATOR_SECRET/BLS_KEY_PATH. Values below are the REAL live cross-chain pilot deployment (ops/testnet/deployments/2026-07-15-xchain-pilot/pilot.json) — copy and repoint for a fresh deployment, do not point production at this pilot.

mezo._swapQuoterNote: Tigris QuoterV2 for depth-aware min-out, and it is NOW MANDATORY (SHARED_SWAP_POLICY, ops/task-engine/threshold-config.mjs): with this empty, both the proposer and every operator refuse every swap-bearing task and capital stays idle. Mezo MAINNET 0x4E56aF2d49D3D8F9a99155b31dd117ccDD545dC7, matsnet 0x84771b080B440BB3Beb67489407F4B8f0552BfC8 (the value below, matching this file's matsnet legs -- REPOINT IT for mainnet). SLIPSTREAM ABI (int24 tickSpacing, not uint24 fee) -- the Uniswap V3 selector reverts on it. Set the SAME address on the aggregator and on every operator: they each quote independently and each bounds with what its own quoter says.

eth._comment: Destination leg — Ethereum Sepolia. No trusted notifier: ALLOCATE is verified purely against this leg's own USDC receiver balance, read via eth_call (see ops/operator/verify.mjs). 2026-07-19: the prior additional Mezo-side BridgeSent eth_getLogs cross-check was removed — receiver balance is the sole and sufficient gate.

_minOutPolicyNote: 2026-08-10. THE SLIPPAGE AND ROUND-TRIP POLICY IS NOT IN THIS FILE AT ALL. minOutBps, maxRoundTripLossBps and requireDepthAwareQuote live in SHARED_SWAP_POLICY (ops/task-engine/threshold-config.mjs), a CONSTANT that resolveTrackedThresholds overlays onto both the aggregator's and every operator's resolved config -- so there is exactly one visible source of these numbers and a host cannot restate, or contradict, any of them. They were briefly present here as ignored values, which is its own hazard: a field that looks settable and is not invites someone to 'fix' a bound by editing it. WHY A CONSTANT: the proposer floored min-out at minOutBps 50 while operators bounded with maxSlippageBps 100 -- two keys for one knob -- so a quorum would have co-signed a min-out twice as slack as the proposer builds, in the one check that stops a sandwich. maxSlippageBps is deleted everywhere. poolFeeBps STAYS here because it is the VENUE's fee tier (Tigris CL MUSD/mUSDC mainnet = 5) and only resolveMinOut's degraded branch reads it; depth-aware quoting is mandatory, so that branch is unreachable in production and this is a mock-pool-test value, not a live bound. REQUIRING DEPTH-AWARE QUOTES MAKES legs.mezo.swapQuoter MANDATORY on the aggregator AND every operator: with no quoter reachable both sides refuse every swap-bearing task and capital stays idle -- by design, and visible as placement-blocked / swap-back-blocked in the log.
_withdrawBatchSumThresholdNote: The withdrawal batch's notional (openBatchShares * candidate navRay / 1e27) must cross this before an operator will co-sign closing it. Missing/0 = no gate. It lives here in the config layer rather than on-chain, and it is tracked in git (see ops/task-engine/threshold-config.mjs) so a host-local edit cannot widen it. Already-closed batches are exempt — the gate is about opening a settlement, not about finishing one.
_secretGeneration: OPERATOR_SECRET (per-seat HMAC key, never shared) and BLS_KEY_PATH are supplied via environment/files, never in this config. Generate a secret with: node -e "console.log(require('crypto').randomBytes(32).toString('hex'))"
_placementBufferFloorBpsNote: The Mezo buffer floor, in bps of totalAssets. THIS IS THE ONLY FLOOR THAT EXISTS: the vault's own bufferFloorBps -- storage, initializer parameter and dual-org propose/confirm ceremony -- was deleted 2026-08-10 (owner: "no need for guards"), so nothing on chain holds a cushion back. It binds because the aggregator AND every operator apply the same placeableAfterBufferFloor(), and because the number is git-tracked (threshold-config.mjs) so a host-local edit to 0 cannot widen it without a commit. WHAT THE CHAIN STILL GUARANTEES regardless: placeableSurplus() nets closed-batch obligations and the open batch's shares marked at NAV, and _handlePlacement reverts ExceedsPlaceableSurplus -- placement can never strand liquidity a batch is counting on. That is solvency, and it is unconditional. This floor is about redemption LATENCY: placing through it loses nobody's money, it means the next withdrawal needs a venue unwind plus a bridge round trip instead of settling locally. THE RISK, stated plainly: four colluding operators, or a bug in the shared function, can now drain the buffer to exactly the reserved amount. Nothing underneath will stop it. A withdrawal arriving after that waits for an unwind rather than failing, so the exposure is delay, not loss.
_thresholdNote: APPROVED BY THE OWNER 2026-08-10: close a withdrawal batch once 100 MUSD of notional is queued, with 24 h as the liveness backstop for a queue that never reaches it. Amount-first by instruction -- the backstop is the floor of the redemption SLA, not the trigger. WHY A LOW TRIGGER IS RIGHT rather than a compromise: the 15% Mezo buffer is what keeps a withdrawal off Ethereum, so a buffer-covered close costs one signing round and ~$0.10 of gas -- no swap, no bridge, nothing to batch for. Ethereum deallocation/bridge-back/swap happen only for the exact remaining shortfall when the buffer is short. NOTE the buffer does NOT guarantee every withdrawal: repeated withdrawals can deplete it. Both keys are git-tracked, so this file binds them and a host cannot widen either. Supersedes the matsnet-era $12, which was never a mainnet decision.
